messages.author: d2343caab336f06d
messages.subject: Occumulti detection estimation
parts:
Hi!

I am trying to figure out a way to model detection probability in Occumulti such that both my species have the same detection probability.  I am modeling squirrel interactions and it is reasonable to me to assume that detection between the species is similar, this is supported by the P  estimates produced by Occumulti (0.32 vs. 0.25). However it seems that the model will only produce distinct detection estimates for each species.  I would rather save model complexity for my main questions (i.e. what habitat features determines co-occurrence or exclusion).  Does anyone have suggestions?

Hi Adia,

Unfortunately, this isn't currently possible with occuMulti. I'll look into implementing it in the future.
